person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and consistently refers to Neely and other characters in the third person. All apparent first-person evidence in the supplied quotes is local character speech: q01096 is Mal's embedded Vietnam account, while q01094 and q01098–q01100 come from funeral addresses. Thus several upstream event buckets contain clipped speech rather than base narration. Authorized opening prose, whole-book library text, scholarly cross-section analysis, and two explicit POV guides agree on third person, with no credible evidence of alternating narration.
